title: Owner-ordered direct roadmap operations
description: Use only when the LPM workspace owner orders a direct roadmap edit (ordem do dono): commit, item edit, archive/restore, bulk, TSV import, dependencies, allocations, item approval (aprovar), materialização, governance mode. Not for one new item or capability, or change requests (use lpm-roadmap).
doneWhen: The owner-ordered operation is committed and a roadmap re-read shows the expected values or counts.
authorityCeiling: Every [O] call needs the owner's explicit order, quoted from this conversation.
jobs: I am the workspace owner: commit these roadmap edits directly, without review
importa esta planilha TSV no roadmap do workspace
aprova o item <title> do roadmap e materializa em requisitos do projeto <name>
arquivar em massa os itens do roadmap <roadmap> (sou o dono)
allocate project <name> as primary on roadmap item <title>
add a dependency: roadmap item A depends on item B
o item do roadmap A depende do item B: cria a dependência (sou o dono)
switch the roadmap governance mode to enforce
preview and apply the roadmap governance migration, then roll it back if needed

notFor.when: reading the roadmap, tracing an item, or any change without an explicit owner order (change request: preview, submit, review, apply)
creating a roadmap or a capability
an item's technical impact or what the code already does
editing, baselining or publishing the requirements created by a materialization
publishing a roadmap note as a knowledge or help article

sharedRefs.name: authority-and-owner-decisions
sharedRefs.loadWhen: background on [O] and decision requests; the playbooks hold the gates and the decision request text

references.loadWhen: playbook owner-commit: create items, or edit item, roadmap or capability text, in one owner commit
playbook items: update, archive or restore items, or archive a roadmap
playbook lifecycle: move one item through a lifecycle gate (approve, deliver, close)
playbook dependency: add, change or remove a dependency between roadmap items
playbook allocation: add, change or remove a project allocation on an item
playbook import: import a TSV file of roadmap items
playbook import-links: link and allocate the items of an import
playbook materialize: materialize an approved item into one project
playbook governance: change the governance mode, or run the enforce window the owner chose
playbook migration: apply or roll back a roadmap migration (governance or v2)
background for maintainers: the path of each owner operation in enforce mode; the playbooks hold the rules
background on the TSV import format; playbooks import and import-links hold the steps

codex.shortDescription: Owner-ordered direct LPM roadmap edits, imports, migrations
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-roadmap-owner-ops to run the roadmap operation the LPM workspace owner ordered: <operation>.
